description: This Java class represents the entity 'LoanInterestRecalculationDetails' for holding interest recalculation settings related to a loan. It includes mappings to database columns, constructors, getters, and methods for creating instances from product details and updating associated loans.

classes.name: LoanInterestRecalculationDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing interest recalculation details for a loan, including various timing, frequency, and calculation strategies.
